fields.question: User question in Traditional Chinese
fields.answer: Verified answer grounded in the reference
fields.verified_at: Date when the source was checked

validation_rules: Every QA must have a unique ID.
Every question and answer must be non-empty.
Every QA must have at least one keyword.
Difficulty must be easy, medium, or hard.
Every answer must be supported by its reference.
Source URLs must be checked before finalization.
No fabricated references or unsupported technical claims.
